# Accounts
> capability: accounts | key: ACC | updated: 2026-10-20

## Purpose
Who can create and access an account, and how they recover access.

## Requirements

### Requirement: ACC-R1 Sign in
When a registered user enters their email and password, the system SHALL sign them in.

#### Scenario: ACC-R1.S1 Correct password
- GIVEN a registered user with email "ana@example.com"
- WHEN they sign in with the correct password
- THEN they see their account home

#### Scenario: ACC-R1.S2 Wrong password
- GIVEN a registered user with email "ana@example.com"
- WHEN they sign in with a wrong password
- THEN they see "email or password is wrong"

### Requirement: ACC-R2 Remember me
Where the user ticks "remember me", the system SHOULD keep them signed in for 30 days.

#### Scenario: ACC-R2.S1 Stay signed in
- GIVEN a user who signed in with "remember me"
- WHEN they come back after 10 days
- THEN they are still signed in

### Requirement: ACC-R3 Two-factor code
When a user with two-factor sign-in enabled enters a correct password, the system SHALL ask for a one-time code.
Quality: security

#### Scenario: ACC-R3.S1 Code requested
- GIVEN a user with two-factor sign-in enabled
- WHEN they enter the correct password
- THEN they are asked for a one-time code
- AND they are not signed in yet
